Hummingbird.name: Colibri
Hummingbird.description:
No frills, just raw processing power.

2 slots only for Hardware

+1 to NET Actions each turn.

Kaliya.name: Kaliya
Kaliya.description:
A fantastic option for dismantling hostile Netrunners. Just hope they don't have any Black ICE.

6 slots for Programs or Hardware, 3 extra slots only for Flak programs.

Restrictions for Defender Programs and Black ICE: Only Flak and Asp can be installed in any slot.

Kerberos.name: Cerbère
Kerberos.description:
Unleash the fires of Hell upon your rivals.

6 slots for Programs, 5 slots for Hardware.

Program slots will only accept Hellhound Black ICE.

Kestrel 2.name: Kestrel 2
Kestrel 2.description:
Black ICE can't hit what they can't catch.

7 slots only for Programs.

Right after Jacking In, Netrunner can activate a maximum of 2 installed Speedy Gonzalvez Programs without a NET Action.

Kirama Advanced Deck.name: Console avancée Kirama
Kirama Advanced Deck.description:
Though it may not be the flashiest choice, Kirama's finest Cyberdeck is expertly balanced and offers some highly practical safety features.

5 slots for Programs or Hardware.

Netrunner suffers no negative effects from an Unsafe Jack Out.

Kirama Entry Deck.name: Console d'entrée de gamme Kirama
Kirama Entry Deck.description:
An affordable and balanced Cyberdeck for novice Netrunners. Though limited by its modest hardware specs, it retains the advanced safety features of Kirama's flagship Cyberdecks.

5 slots only for Programs.

Only one of each Program category can be installed at a time (Attacker, Defender, Booster, Black ICE). Netrunner suffers no negative effects from an Unsafe Jack Out.

Kirama Training Deck.name: Console d'entraînement Kirama
Kirama Training Deck.description:
The quintessential starter Cyberdeck. Bargain-bin price with bare-minimum hardware specs.

5 slots only for Programs.

Netrunner must be 2m/yds or closer to Access Point to Jack In. All brain damage from NET combat is doubled.

MicroMate.name: MicroPote
MicroMate.description:
Perfect for Netrunners who only know one speed: All offense, all the time. Just don't get hit, it's going to hurt. A lot.

9 slots for Programs or Hardware.

Slots will not accept Defender Programs. All brain damage from NET combat is doubled.

Microtech Assault.name: Microtech Assaut
Microtech Assault.description:
Relax and let your Black ICE do all the heavy lifting.

4 slots for Programs, 5 slots for Hardware.

Program slots only accept Black ICE.

Microtech Scout.name: Microtech Scout
Microtech Scout.description:
5 slots for Programs or Hardware.

Netrunner can roll Pathfinder without a NET Action right after Jacking In.

Microtech Warrior.name: Guerrier Microtech
Microtech Warrior.description:
7 Slots only for Programs.

Netrunner can activate one Armor Program without a NET Action right after Jacking In.

Parraline 6000.name: Parraline 6000
Parraline 6000.description:
All the Hardware options with none of the restrictions.

3 Program slots, 6 Hardware slots.

Phoenix.name: Phénix
Phoenix.description:
Never lose a Program again.

6 slots for Programs or Hardware.

Any Program destroyed in a netrunning session is restored upon a safe Jack Out.

Verdant Knight.name: Chevalier Verdoyant
Verdant Knight.description:
The classic sword-and-board Cyberdeck build is highly effective against Black ICE. Just don't plan on going toe-to-toe with a hostile Netrunner.

9 slots only for Programs.

Slots only accept Sword or Shield Programs.

Warlock's Book.name: Grimoire Du Sorcier
Warlock's Book.description:
If you prefer sliding through NET Architectures avoiding Black ICE this is the deck for you.

9 slots to install either Programs or Hardware.

No Attacker or Black ICE Program may be installed.

Smart Ears.name: Smart Ears
Smart Ears.description:
A wearable headset with integrated Radio Scanner / Music Player and 2 empty Cyberaudio slots.

Remember to set HL to 0 when installing cyberwear options.

Spider Cyberchair.name: Cybersiège Spider
Spider Cyberchair.description:
The top of the line cyberchair, giving the premier user many options. While using it the operator's base MOVE becomes 5, with all regular movement options remaining available. Operation of the cyberchair requires either a free hand, or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{interface plugs}.

Any cyberware options installed into this device always count as being paired.

If the operator suffers a critical injury that reduces their MOVE, the cyberchair is affected instead.

A Box Bound Tightly In Rope.name: A Box Bound Tightly In Rope
A Box Bound Tightly In Rope.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.uq1cseo3a1hAx7Pg]{A Box Bound Tightly in Rope}

A Box Covered In Chipped Paint.name: A Box Covered In Chipped Paint
A Box Covered In Chipped Paint.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.xWZowpQzG7fpmoP7]{A Box Covered in Chipped Paint}

A Box Dripping Wet With Fluid.name: A Box Dripping Wet With Fluid
A Box Dripping Wet With Fluid.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.zRHyYnlEqNlTA4l5]{A Box Dripping Wet With Fluid}

A Box Freezing Cold To The Touch.name: A Box Freezing Cold To The Touch
A Box Freezing Cold To The Touch.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.VszxZ4TJjQ8FGuoc]{A Box Freezing Cold To The Touch}

A Box Handsomely Gift Wrapped.name: A Box Handsomely Gift Wrapped
A Box Handsomely Gift Wrapped.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.4S3emhUCIIDNoTAg]{A Box Handsomely Gift Wrapped}

A Box Marked With A Lime Green X.name: A Box Marked With A Lime Green X
A Box Marked With A Lime Green X.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.T6pocp9VStxtFPzP]{A Box Marked With A Lime Green X}

A Box Melted Out Of Shape.name: A Box Melted Out Of Shape
A Box Melted Out Of Shape.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.bOtq937SNIahmbeK]{A Box Melted Out Of Shape}

A Box Reeking Of Oil.name: A Box Reeking Of Oil
A Box Reeking Of Oil.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.EVPuZ21eNOpEycGQ]{A Box Reeking Of Oil}

A Box Sealed With A Lipstick Kiss.name: A Box Sealed With A Lipstick Kiss
A Box Sealed With A Lipstick Kiss.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.McQc33tLYAp7djIV]{A Box Sealed With A Lipstick Kiss}

A Box Showing Signs Of Repair.name: A Box Showing Signs Of Repair
A Box Showing Signs Of Repair.description: Roll once from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.WmWdGRlhzhA2ZcmV]{A Box Showing Signs Of Repair}

A Touch of Luxury Furniture Set.name: Set de meubles Une touche d'élégance
A Touch of Luxury Furniture Set.description: This Furniture Set makes your Cargo Container almost feel like a home.

All-Purpose Soundproofing.name: All-Purpose Soundproofing
All-Purpose Soundproofing.description:
Enjoy peace and quiet in even the loudest neighborhood.

Does not prevent @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.9pZMYMlVFeWDS56L]{Amplified Hearing} cyberware from eavesdropping.

Apartment Affability Furniture Set.name: Apartment Affability Furniture Set
Apartment Affability Furniture Set.description: Easy to assemble furniture in a box. This is the starting Furniture Set for most Apartments and Corporate Conapts.

Binary Compound.name: Binary Compound
Binary Compound.description:
A double-syringe that contains a pair of corrosive chemicals capable of eating through solid objects.

Requires 2 rounds to apply — Stays active for 6 rounds

Deals [[/r 6d6 #Binary Compound Damage]] damage per round.

Branded Jumpsuit (Extreme Security).name: Branded Jumpsuit (Extreme Security)
Branded Jumpsuit (Extreme Security).description: A jacket or jumpsuit that appears commonplace in an extremely secure environment.

Branded Jumpsuit (High Security).name: Branded Jumpsuit (High Security)
Branded Jumpsuit (High Security).description: A jacket or jumpsuit that appears commonplace in a high security environment.

Branded Jumpsuit (Low Security).name: Branded Jumpsuit (Low Security)
Branded Jumpsuit (Low Security).description: A jacket or jumpsuit that appears commonplace in a low security environment.

Branded Jumpsuit (Moderate Security).name: Branded Jumpsuit (Moderate Security)
Branded Jumpsuit (Moderate Security).description: A jacket or jumpsuit that appears commonplace in a medium security environment.

Breacher.name: Breacher
Breacher.description: A pocket-sized electronic device designed specifically for hacking agents.

Bullet To Slug Adapter Casings.name: Douilles adaptatrices de balles vers slugs
Bullet To Slug Adapter Casings.description: A box of 10 casings and a loading jig. Replace 10 bullets of any type with a corresponding Shotgun Slug as an action.

Cargo Container Chic Furniture Set.name: Set de meubles Aménagement standard
Cargo Container Chic Furniture Set.description: It might be cheap, but it is real furniture. This is the starting Furniture Set for most Cargo Containers.

Chicken Coop (Basic).name: Chicken Coop (Basic)
Chicken Coop (Basic).description: A home for your chickens to lay eggs or fatten up.

Chicken (Hen).name: Chicken (Hen)
Chicken (Hen).description: Feed it leftover kibble crumbs and it might lay eggs.

Chicken (Rooster).name: Chicken (Rooster)
Chicken (Rooster).description: Feed it leftover kibble crumbs to fatten it up.

Concealment Sleeve.name: Concealment Sleeve
Concealment Sleeve.description:
A custom fit RealSkinn™ sleeve made just for you.

All installed cyberware concealed by this sleeve becomes undetectable by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.JMYvZfk6ZBgt6tK0]{Cyberscanners} and unusable until the sleeve is removed. — No automation provided.

Counts as a Very Expensive item — price categories are currently hardcoded by the system.

Continental Brands Real Instant Coffee™.name: Continental Brands Real Instant Coffee™
Continental Brands Real Instant Coffee™.description: Now made from real coffee beans! Makes 24 cups.

Continental Brands SmartOven.name: Continental Brands SmartOven
Continental Brands SmartOven.description: Transforms bland kibble into a delicious hot meal. (Unflavored Kibble sold separately.)

CrAB Drone.name: CrAB Drone
CrAB Drone.description:
Can be neutralized in 5 min with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech.skills.electronicOrSecurityTech #DV21 Electronic/Security Tech]]{DV21 Electronic/Security Tech} check. This drone is equipped with:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.clCxd7qkp2olsKii]{Observation Camera}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.aEG91CA3amfU0Q8U]{Grip Feet}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Th74cfC87RqEJKAb]{Airhypo}

    • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_drugs.Item.6BM5WFyCyIM8lZib]{Black Lace}

    • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_drugs.Item.UrKzMiFp4xFOLNIC]{Blue Glass}

    • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.tr7G2kdlPBTvyTON]{Biotoxin}

Creative Couture Furniture Set.name: Creative Couture Furniture Set
Creative Couture Furniture Set.description: Furnished with military surplus gear and recycled materials. The bare minimum needed to furnish your Apartment.

Cybercam EX-1.name: Cybercam EX-1
Cybercam EX-1.description: Head-mounted camera. A Media presenting a story on a livestream while wearing the Cybercam EX-1 gains +1 Credibility when using their role ability. This stacks with evidence based bonuses.

Cyberscanner.name: Cyberscanner
Cyberscanner.description:
Can scan an individual within 2m/yds and provide a list of all installed Cyberware, takes 1 minute. Spits out an error if a Hardened, Tech Upgraded, or Unique piece of Cyberware is detected.

No automation provided

Delaying Compound.name: Composé retardateur
Delaying Compound.description:
This additive delays the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.gaGUmTGViuxZ4mqR]{Poison} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.tr7G2kdlPBTvyTON]{Biotoxin} vial by up to an hour.

Mixing multiple Delaying Compounds does not increase delay period.

Desirous Decoration Furniture Set.name: Desirous Decoration Furniture Set
Desirous Decoration Furniture Set.description: This Furniture Set is not just a small collection of art and matching furniture, it's an investment in personal comfort.

Distilling Compound.name: Composé de Distillation
Distilling Compound.description:
This additive increases the Resist Torture/Drugs DV of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.gaGUmTGViuxZ4mqR]{Poison} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.tr7G2kdlPBTvyTON]{Biotoxin} vials by 2.

Effects do not stack.

Diving Rebreather.name: Diving Rebreather
Diving Rebreather.description: A self-contained underwater breathing apparatus that recycles your exhaled breath instead of releasing it into the water as bubbles.

DM 5000 Adelhyde.name: DM 5000 Adelhyde
DM 5000 Adelhyde.description:
Each ingredient canister holds 100 units and must be replaced when empty.

Used for tracking the fill state of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.rl7LT2WYItMqMoLm]{Drink Master 5000}

DM 5000 Bronson Extract.name: DM 5000 Bronson Extract
DM 5000 Bronson Extract.description:
Each ingredient canister holds 100 units and must be replaced when empty.

Used for tracking the fill state of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.rl7LT2WYItMqMoLm]{Drink Master 5000}

DM 5000 Flanergide.name: DM 5000 Flanergide
DM 5000 Flanergide.description:
Each ingredient canister holds 100 units and must be replaced when empty.

Used for tracking the fill state of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.rl7LT2WYItMqMoLm]{Drink Master 5000}

DM 5000 Karmotrine.name: DM 5000 Karmotrine
DM 5000 Karmotrine.description:
Each ingredient canister holds 100 units and must be replaced when empty.

Used for tracking the fill state of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.rl7LT2WYItMqMoLm]{Drink Master 5000}

DM 5000 Powdered Delta.name: DM 5000 Powdered Delta
DM 5000 Powdered Delta.description:
Each ingredient canister holds 100 units and must be replaced when empty.

Used for tracking the fill state of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.rl7LT2WYItMqMoLm]{Drink Master 5000}

Dosimeter Badge.name: Dosimeter Badge
Dosimeter Badge.description: A personal device worn to monitor radiation exposure. Alerts user when dangerous radiation levels are detected within 10m/yds.

Drink Master 5000.name: Cocktailotron 5000
Drink Master 5000.description:
A large, cabinet-sized, drink mixing machine commonly used in bars. Provides 30 HP for the purposes of cover. See the Drinktionary on pg 16 of Mixing Drinks—Changing Lives for associated recipes.

Each ingredient canister holds 100 units and must be replaced when empty. You may use the following items to track Drink Master 5000's fill state:

@UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.Ig15Vp79R4lMkHGu]{Adelhyde} @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.P6IU6Vm16NgPHJt4]{Bronson Extract} @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.eejNk5t7hvr5BsJA]{Powdered Delta} @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.NjFzze9SENjPu2U3]{Flanergide} @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.87tePbq5yTJxEg49]{Karmotrine}

Fire Safe.name: Coffre-fort ignifugé
Fire Safe.description: Small fireproof lockbox made of Thick Steel with 50HP. Can be opened with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech+@skills.pickLock #DV15 Pick Lock]]{DV15 Pick Lock} check.

Flippers.name: Flippers
Flippers.description: A set of diving fins. Negates swimming movement penalty.

Fuel Tank.name: Fuel Tank
Fuel Tank.description: A generic fuel tank that can be used to track your supply.

GRAF3 Drone.name: GRAF3 Drone
GRAF3 Drone.description:
Quadruped construction drone. Can be neutralized in 5 min with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech.skills.electronicOrSecurityTech #DV17 Electronic/Security Tech]]{DV17 Electronic/Security Tech} check. This drone is equipped with:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.PxOjhUUs7cRULv75]{Very Heavy Melee}

Green Light Go Sniffer.name: Sniffeur Green Light Go
Green Light Go Sniffer.description: Provides a green or red glow depending on if the chemical substance (such as Street Drugs or Pharmaceuticals) is clean or cut/mixed with another substance.

Handprint Glove.name: Handprint Glove
Handprint Glove.description:
A glove fabricated from RealSkinn™ that allows you wear somebody else's handprint.

Capable of fooling Handprint Scanners, but not leaving fingerprints.

Counts as a Very Expensive item — price categories are currently hardcoded by the system.

Hidden Compartment.name: Compartiment secret
Hidden Compartment.description: A small hidden compartment inside your Cargo Container. Can be located with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.int+@skills.concealOrRevealObject #DV15 Conceal/Reveal Object]]{DV15 Conceal/Reveal Object} check

Húsafell Hydraulic Underjack.name: Húsafell Hydraulic Underjack
Húsafell Hydraulic Underjack.description:
Waterproof all-weather hydraulic undershirt raises BODY by 2, but not higher than 10.

Incompatible with Linear Frames & @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.Lx9FSNDEIxLZ7Pyh]{Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace}.

Inline Skates.name: Rollers
Inline Skates.description:
They're roller skates baby!

Increases movement by 4m/yds when taking the Run action.

May cause physical tasks to be done at -2.

Ion Cuffs.name: Menottes Ion
Ion Cuffs.description: Handcuffs meant for borgs. Disables any Non-Hardened Cyberware options installed in limbs the cuffs are binding. Cannot prevent the escape of cyborgs with BODY greater than 13.

Kibble Pack: Mystery.name: Kibble Pack: Mystery
Kibble Pack: Mystery.description: One meal. Which @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_rolltables.RollTable.wYySmunH9lfLbhN9]{Kibble Flavor} will it be?

Koff Popper.name: Koff Popper
Koff Popper.description: The only thermos/brewer combo you'll ever need.

Koff Pops.name: Koff Pops
Koff Pops.description:
Koff Pops used with the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.LUc8nYLERP5vhxyT]{Continental Brands Koff Popper}.

Included in Kibble or higher lifestyle

Laser Microphone.name: Laser Microphone
Laser Microphone.description:
An invisible laser allows the user to measure vibrations and eavesdrop through glass windows up to 300m/yds away.

The laser may become visible in foggy or smokey conditions.

Audio vibrations are completely blocked by Thick Bulletproof Glass.

Linear Frame Ω (Omega).name: Charpente linéaire Ω (Omega)
Linear Frame Ω (Omega).description:
Exoskeleton.

  • Requires 3 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plugs}

  • Increases BODY to 16 while plugged in

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system.

MagViewer.name: MagJumelles
MagViewer.description:
Binoculars meant for spotting. Provides detail up to 800m/yds. Provides another individual with a +1 to their attack roll against a shared target if you make a successful Complimentary Skill Check.

This bonus does not stack with the bonuses provided by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_upgrades.Item.Ryex0KHeeDzPQwmN]{Sniping Scope} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.uApwuxpuIJMe47Vn]{TeleOptics}.

Master Mechanic's Tool Kit.name: Kit d'outils Master Mécanique
Master Mechanic's Tool Kit.description:
A massive tool chest that provides +4 bonus to Basic Tech, Cybertech, Electronic/Security Tech, Weaponstech, Land Vehicle Tech, Sea Vehicle Tech, Air Vehicle Tech checks.

Large enough to be considered Thick Steel Cover

Requires BODY 10 to move

Mercurius Cyberchair.name: Cybersiège Mercurius
Mercurius Cyberchair.description:
An impressively affordable cyberchair, offering great features at this price point. While using it the operator's base MOVE becomes 5, with all regular movement options remaining available. Operation requires either a free hand, or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{interface plugs}.

If the operator suffers a critical injury that reduces their MOVE, the cyberchair is affected instead.

Militech M97 Ghostsuit.name: Militech M97 Ghostsuit
Militech M97 Ghostsuit.description: Automatically blend into your surroundings after 1 minute without moving. Requires a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.int+@skills.perception #DV17 Perception]]{DV17 Perception} check to spot. The effect ends if you move more than 2m/yds per turn.

MiniMag Speakers.name: Haut-parleurs MiniMag
MiniMag Speakers.description: Small Magnetic Speakers. Can play audio from a connected @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}within 100m/yds.

ModBall Construction Kit.name: ModBall Construction Kit
ModBall Construction Kit.description:
Allows anyone to create their own ModBall ammunition. All ModBalls take 1 hour to fabricate as if the user were a Tech with Fabrication Expertise 2.

Modball Type

Cost / ModBall

Fabrication Cost

Fabrication DV

My First GRAF3.name: Mon Premier GRAF3
My First GRAF3.description: Personal Drone. Tiny GRAF3 that can be linked to an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}. Can be neutralized in 5 min with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech.skills.electronicOrSecurityTech #DV9 Electronic/Security Tech]]{DV9 Electronic/Security Tech} check.

NASS-54 Underwater Drone.name: NASS-54 Underwater Drone
NASS-54 Underwater Drone.description:
A semi-autonomous torpedeo drone produced by Militech. Can be neutralized in 5 min with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech.skills.electronicOrSecurityTech #DV21 Electronic/Security Tech]]{DV21 Electronic/Security Tech} check. This drone is equipped with:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.clCxd7qkp2olsKii]{Observation Camera}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.JwM7wAbmRZfL3Z3c]{Sonar}

  • Retractable Manipulator Arm

    • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.hAx2MqVm4JuwXsSV]{Tool Hand}

    • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.PxOjhUUs7cRULv75]{Circular Saw}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.KgqUdz9Fs55747gv]{Grenade Launchers} x2

Osmosis Compound.name: Composé d'Osmose
Osmosis Compound.description: This additive allows a vial of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.gaGUmTGViuxZ4mqR]{Poison} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.tr7G2kdlPBTvyTON]{Biotoxin} to be absorbed through skin contact. A [[/r 1d10red+@stats.int+@skills.perception #DV17 Perception]]{DV17 Perception} check can spot the poison. Lasts for one hour or until washed away by water.

Parabolic Microphone.name: Parabolic Microphone
Parabolic Microphone.description: A handheld microphone that allows the user to amplify sounds up to 30m/yds away when used with a linked @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Lo7rXsc5ToQf2KlN]{Audio Recorder}

Power Chord.name: Cordes de puissance
Power Chord.description:
Shred righteous bars with this @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.aiX4CSRjs0oKGIFK]{electric guitar}. Non-Rockerboys suffer the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-body.Item.IKKcCgHU1lBJ4wVd]{Crushed Fingers} injury if they play this instrument longer than 10 minutes.

Enable the supplied active effect only if your musician has a base skill rank of 16 in @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_skills-play-instrument.Item.WS1dbopsk9h1uTSn]{Play Instrument (Guitar)}.

Ultra durable construction cannot be damaged by fire or any weapon that deals less than 6d6.

PressureTech Shower Head.name: PressureTech Shower Head
PressureTech Shower Head.description:
Pressure-wash the stress away.

Using this shower deals 1 damage to an unarmored target.

Professional Disguise Kit.name: Professional Disguise Kit
Professional Disguise Kit.description: With a combination of stage makeup and RealSkinn™ prosthetics you can look like a whole new you! Provides a +2 bonus to Personal Grooming checks.

Remote Camera Drone.name: Remote Camera Drone
Remote Camera Drone.description:
A personal drone that must be directly controlled via a connected Agent. The drone is equipped with:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.clCxd7qkp2olsKii]{Observation Camera}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_cyberware.Item.ViH7d2nQAg0dLQuD]{Holographic Projector}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.KgqUdz9Fs55747gv]{Smoke Grenade Launcher}

Retina Lenses.name: Retina Lenses
Retina Lenses.description:
A fabricated lens imprinted with a copy of somebody's retinal patterns. You must provide the Tech with a valid retinal pattern prior to fabrication.

Capable of fooling Retinal Scanners.

Roller Derby Skates.name: Patins de Roller Derby
Roller Derby Skates.description:
A pair of Derby League approved quad-skates.

Increases movement by 4m/yds when taking the run action.

May cause physical tasks to be done at -2.

Savannah Eagle Drone.name: Savannah Eagle Drone
Savannah Eagle Drone.description:
